checks.name: all_16_direction_semantics
checks.evidence: All four cardinals are unambiguous. All twelve intermediate labels retain the expected quadrant and circular order; four near-horizontal labels receive warnings.

checks.name: scale_and_baseline
checks.evidence: Contact sheet and native-size frame composites show a stable clock-body scale. Standing states share the foot baseline; deliberate crouch, tilt and airborne poses are consistent with their states.

checks.name: continuous_amber_glow
checks.evidence: qa/final-previews/four-stills.png and native frames composited over dark slate show a continuous soft amber halo around the silhouette. No square border or isolated dirty patches are visible.

checks.name: dense_body
checks.evidence: Clock face remains solid orange with stable dark outline and readable features on both checkerboard and dark backgrounds.

checks.name: symmetric_running
checks.evidence: All eight running-right and all eight running-left native frames have matching scale and mirrored gait phases, with alternating leg poses and coherent arm attachments.

checks.name: jump_size_and_return
checks.evidence: All five jumping frames preserve clock diameter through crouch, ascent, apex and descent; last frame returns both feet to the standing baseline.

checks.name: planted_work
checks.evidence: All six running/work frames keep both feet planted while eye, head and hand gestures vary. No locomotion step appears in this row.

checks.name: connected_limbs
checks.evidence: Inspected native running, jumping and work/review sequences plus full contact sheet. Arms connect to the body or overlap coherently; gloves and shoes connect to their limbs.

checks.name: temporal_playback
checks.evidence: This review inspected ordered still sequences and contact sheets; it did not independently run animated playback or inspect timing in the target application.
